plan.notes: Source: SUNY New Paltz official 8-semester plan PDF (Marketing), from the catalog's GE3 8-semester-plan set. The plan PDF states no catalog year (footer generation stamp 6/28/2019); business course numbers verified against the current official catalog Marketing program page on 2026-10-09 (newpaltz-preview.courseleaf.com): the 40-credit business core sequence and all five sample General Marketing track courses (BUS327, BUS360, BUS427, BUS429, BUS386) are current - disclosed here; filed as 2024-2025. The School of Business offers the Bachelor of Science in Marketing (AACSB-accredited), verified via the catalog program page. Transcribed exactly as published: 15+15+15+16+15+15+15+15 = 121 (PDF footer: "Total Credits: 121"). The five "(sample)" track courses are transcribed as choice slots against the plan's General Marketing track list (Note 3); the current program page adds BUS391 and BUS452 to that list - documented in the slot notes. Note 4 (Food Marketing track) documented in plan notes for reference: BUS328 Food Retail Management, BUS329 Food Category Management, BUS429 Marketing Strategy, plus two of BUS327/BUS360/BUS386/BUS427/BUS430/BUS452. Applied Learning requirement transcribed as a choice slot per Note 5. BUS093/BUS095 are 0-credit workshops, as printed. Prerequisites recorded only for direct in-plan chains (BUS202 after BUS201; BUS311 after BUS309; BUS326 after BUS325). Plan Note 1: courses offered in the specified semesters. Note 2: GE order suggestive except Composition (must be completed in the first year) and GE/major overlap courses (take in the specified year). The plan is an advising tool ("a starting point for careful discussions between a student and his/her academic adviser").
